prompt:
The charts below show how energy was used in an average home in one country in 1990 and in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Household energy use by purpose, 1990 and 2020
visual.alt: Two pie charts showing what purpose energy was used for in an average home in 1990 and 2020.

key_points: Space heating is by far the largest category in both years, but its share falls from 62% to 48%
The share of appliances and electronics rises from 5% to 21%, more than a fourfold increase, moving it into second place
Water heating stays almost unchanged (18% → 20%) and falls from second place in 1990 to third place in 2020
Lighting and cooking are the smallest shares in both years; both fall slightly
The overall pattern: the weight of heating decreases while the share of electrical appliances grows; the total remains 100%
common_mistakes: Forgetting that the shares are percentages and saying 'more energy was used' — the chart shows distribution, not total consumption
Listing all five slices for both charts one by one instead of highlighting the most striking change (appliances)
Skipping the change in ranking (second place changing hands)
Adding an opinion or recommendation ('homes should insulate better')
